thread.title: EBSCO Information Services launches EBSCOhost AI Exchange to connect AI tools to research
thread.title_full: EBSCO Information Services launches EBSCOhost AI Exchange to connect AI tools to research

author: First State Times
title: EBSCO Information Services launches EBSCOhost AI Exchange to connect AI tools to research
text:
EBSCO Information Services announced on May 20 the launch of EBSCOhost AI Exchange, a new platform designed to connect artificial intelligence systems and applications with licensed, peer-reviewed scholarly content. The company said this initiative aims to ensure that answers generated by AI are based on sources that users can verify and cite.
The introduction of this platform comes as more researchers, students, and professionals turn to AI as their main entry point for information. The quality and reliability of sources behind these answers is becoming increasingly important. EBSCOhost AI Exchange serves as an intermediary between publishers, AI systems, and end users by providing a framework that supports licensed access, proper attribution, and content delivery in line with existing subscriptions and permissions.
“AI is quickly becoming a starting point for research, and the sources behind AI-generated answers matter. EBSCOhost AI Exchange connects AI tools to trusted, licensed content so organizations can deliver answers grounded in real evidence, while keeping libraries and publishers connected to the research process,” said Sam Brooks, Executive Vice President at EBSCO Information Services.
According to the company statement, the platform builds on EBSCO’s longstanding role within academic publishing. It supports various types of AI environments such as commercial tools, institutional models, enterprise platforms, and retrieval-based applications.
Melissa D’Amato, Senior Vice President of Publisher Services at EBSCO Information Services said: “Publishers need a responsible path into AI-supported discovery, one that keeps their content visible, valued, and properly attributed. EBSCOhost AI Exchange is built to provide exactly that.”
EBSCO describes itself as a provider of online research content and search technologies serving libraries; healthcare institutions; corporations; and government agencies worldwide.
